attributes.addressDerivation: CREATE2 from the launcher, with the salt mined until the address carries exactly the declared permission bits; the constructor validates its own bits so a mis-mined salt reverts the launch
attributes.summary: The one immutable hook bound to the canonical PoolKey. It admits exactly one pool once, returns the auctioned LP fee as a beforeSwap override, charges the hook-owned volume fee on executed gross quote-side amounts across all four quadrants, runs the permissionless rent auction and donates accrued rent to in-range positions.

attributes.callerRestriction: deployAndLaunch reverts unless msg.sender is the launch wallet fixed in the constructor, and reverts on any second call
attributes.residualBalance: every unspent unit of both currencies is returned to the launch wallet before the transaction ends
attributes.retainedPosition: the launcher permanently owns the seeded full-range position and exposes no decrease, collect, rescue, arbitrary-call, owner or upgrade path
attributes.summary: Single-use launcher. One transaction deploys the token, deploys the hook at the mined address, initialises the canonical pool, seeds one full-range position and settles both currencies; any mismatch reverts the whole transaction.

attributes.addressDerivation: CREATE2 from the launcher, with the salt mined until the predicted address sorts below the WETH9 address so the launched token is currency0
attributes.summary: Fixed-supply ERC-20 minted once in its constructor to the launcher. No owner, minter, pauser, blacklist, transfer tax, rebase, upgrade path or rescue function exists.

attributes.ordering: after the token, so the mined hook salt commits both sorted currencies
first, so its address fixes the PoolKey currency ordering

attributes.failureRule: a foreign key member, a mismatched start price, an unexpected delta or an over-budget settlement reverts the whole launch
attributes.steps: PoolManager.initialize on the canonical key, then unlock and modifyLiquidity for one full-range position, then sync, transfer and settle for each owed currency
